title: Deputy Manager-Civil-Projects & ME
description:
**Designation: Deputy Manager -Civil-Projects & ME**

**Experience Level: 9-12 Years**

**Location: Satyavedu**

Responsible for project activities - Monitor & execution of new projects, Co-ordinate with CFT team, Architects, PMC, and MEP (electrical and mechanical utilities)

**Detailed responsibilities :**

* Verifying the Good for construction drawings and checking the execution of works as per drawings provided by the architect for the Civil and interior offices works, enclosures, epoxy flooring.
* Assisting in providing safety permits to the vendors for the execution works.
* Monitoring the execution of works as per the project schedule.
* Coordination with the PMC and contractors for execution of the site activities.
* Verifying the on-site measurements after execution and checking the Joint measurement records to the vendors.
* Coordination with the MEP team, production team for the execution of site activities as per the project requirements.
* Supervising the quality of works as per the project requirement.
* Assisting with the PMC team for providing SOR, NCR documentation.
* Coordinating with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure that work is done as per design intent and specifications.
* Assisting in verifying test reports with the PMC for construction materials.
* Assisting in preparing and planning daily progress reports.

Qualification, Experience and Certification – Selection Criteria

Education

BE in
**Civil,**
with relevant experience needed for the position
